history.overview: Scar West became the Muramite Legion’s primary staging ground for canyon operations.

timeline.name: Dragorn Fortification
timeline.description: Dragorn defenders once fortified the western canyon wall.

timeline.name: Muramite Seizure
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the wall and converted it into a staging ground.

timeline.name: Discord Ruptures
timeline.description: Discord energy tore open cracks in the canyon wall.

timeline.name: Resistance Infiltration
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels used cliffside passes to sabotage Muramite supply lines.
